name: eden-press-corpus-gen
description: Dev tooling (not shipped). Generates the Marp golden conformance corpus (CONF-01) by rendering representative Markdown through the real @marp-team/marp-core npm package — the oracle. Regenerate with `npm ci && node gen.mjs`. Output: conformance/corpus/cases/<id>/{input.md,options.json,expected.html,expected.css}.
